name: ling
author: 上海啸群教育科技有限公司
description: Ling 是一个开源 AI 心理咨询框架与桌面应用。

scripts.dev: pnpm rebuild:sqlite:electron && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && concurrently -k "pnpm dev:web" "wait-on http://localhost:45174 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:45174 electron ."
scripts.dev:electron:settings-layout: pnpm rebuild:sqlite:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5194 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5194 && cross-env LING_APP_TITLE='Ling Settings Layout' VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5194 electron ."
scripts.dev:electron:model-access: pnpm rebuild:sqlite:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5195 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5195 && cross-env LING_APP_TITLE='Ling Model Access' VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5195 electron ."
scripts.app:ui-portrait: pnpm rebuild:sqlite:electron && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && concurrently -k "pnpm dev:ui-portrait" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5185 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5185 electron ."
scripts.build: pnpm localization:verify && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/copy-prompt-assets.mjs && node scripts/verify-desktop-build.mjs
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && pnpm rebuild:sqlite:electron && electron-builder --mac dir --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.package:mac:dev: pnpm build && pnpm rebuild:sqlite:electron && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.json --mac dir --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && pnpm rebuild:sqlite:electron && electron-builder --mac dmg --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.rebuild:sqlite:electron: cross-env npm_config_runtime=electron npm_config_target=34.0.2 npm_config_disturl=https://electronjs.org/headers pnpm rebuild better-sqlite3 better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ling 使用麦克风将语音转换为文字。本地模型不会上传音频，云端模式会发送至所选服务。 Ling uses the microphone to turn speech into text. The local model does not upload audio; cloud mode sends it to your selected provider.
